mods.name: Ruckus Perks (Beta)
mods.author: Ruckus
mods.summary: Earn perks and items by surviving the revolver in Liar's Deck.
mods.description:
Pick a perk when the match starts, then earn a stronger item every time you survive the revolver. Make it to 5 of 6 and you get **Bulletproof**.

**How it works**
- At the start, pick 1 of 3 perks like Steady Hand, Tally, Thick Skin or Sharp Ears.
- Each pull you survive offers a better item: Peek, Stall, Card Swap, Mirror, Hand Swap, Loud Mouth, Reload or Pass the Gun.
- Press **Q** on your turn to use an item. You can hold two.

**Everyone at the table needs it.** Players without it are told where to get it and removed from the lobby.

Works in Liar's Deck (Basic and Devil) in your own friends-only or private lobbies. It switches itself off in public lobbies, ranked and other modes.

versions.changelog: First beta: 4 starting perks, 8 items earned by surviving the revolver, and Bulletproof at 5 of 6.
